evidence.behavior_citation: von Philipsborn et al. 2011, Neuronal Control of Drosophila Courtship Song, Neuron 69(3):509-522 (pIP10 command neuron); Shirangi, Wong, Truman & Stern 2016, Doublesex Regulates the Connectivity of a Neural Circuit Controlling Drosophila Male Courtship Song, Developmental Cell 37(6):533-544 (TN1A activates hg1 motoneuron, causal statement); Shirangi, Stern & Truman 2013, Motor control of Drosophila courtship song, Cell Reports 5:678-686 (hg1 motoneuron silencing eliminates sine song specifically)
evidence.confidence_note: Every node AND every functional link in this chain is independently confirmed in prior literature, matching the L-side hotspot's evidentiary standard. Relay selected by explicitly filtering all 22 TN1a subtypes (both L- and R-labeled instances) for connections that terminate at hg1 MN_R specifically, then ranking by summed log1p weight -- not by naming symmetry with the L-side hotspot and not by raw connection strength from pIP10_R alone (both of those simpler approaches were tried first and rejected as methodologically unsound; see notes). TN1a_i_L scored highest (8.246) among all real candidates checked. Neuroglancer-confirmed superclasses match expected roles exactly (descending_neuron / vnc_intrinsic / vnc_motor).

notes: Double-crossing pattern confirmed: TN1a_i_L (an L-labeled relay) is the strongest verified route from pIP10_R to hg1 MN_R, confirmed via ROI-level synapse location (WTct(UTct-T2)(R) for the second hop), not just instance naming. Combined with the L-side hotspot's own single crossing (TN1a_i_L -> hg1 MN_R there too, interestingly the same relay neuron feeds both sides' strongest paths), this suggests the wing-song circuit's L/R wiring is more interleaved than simple mirror symmetry -- stated as an open architectural observation, not resolved. Two earlier candidate paths were considered and rejected during verification: (1) TN1a_i_R, chosen initially by naming symmetry with the L-side hotspot alone, never checked against real data; (2) TN1a_g_R, chosen by strongest raw connection from pIP10_R without checking which hg1 target it reached -- this path actually crosses to hg1 MN_L, which would not visibly drive the right wing and was rejected for that reason despite being anatomically real. TN1a_h_R (803438, weights 105/32) remains a very close alternative (8.160 vs. 8.246) with a simpler non-crossing story and could be substituted if a cleaner narrative is preferred over the marginally higher score.
